shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated ornament dividing registers
bird-like/animal heads with prominent eye and beak or muzzle
justification: Both surfaces are pale stone reliefs organised into horizontal registers, with a repeating decorative band (zigzag/hatching in A, rosettes in B) running above a main field containing a large profile animal accompanied by a smaller upright figure. The decisive difference is manner of execution: A is schematic, shallow and roughly cut with flat, abstracted silhouettes, whereas B is smoothly modelled, anatomically observed and finished with fine detail, so the correspondences remain generic rather than specific.
